# 내셔널 지오그래픽 : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YT4Lr-qyn1o
# 2021 서울고 이종호 학생 수행평가 작품 변형
import random

wm = sphere(pos=vec(20,40,0), radius = 5, make_trail = True, texture = 'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSzw46Gm4xkVZ56DJuXWVXtdXpkQ6LUSdWXog&usqp=CAU')
wm.v = vec(0,0,0)

balls = []
for i in range(10):
    ball = sphere(pos=vec(-20,0,0), make_trail = True)
    x = random.randint(10, 50)
    ball.v = vec(x,x,0)
    balls.append(ball)

while True:
    rate(30)   
    # ball
    for ball in balls:
        ball.pos = ball.pos + ball.v * 0.01
        ball.v.y = ball.v.y + -9.8 * 0.01
        
    # watermellon
    wm.v.y = wm.v.y + -9.8 * 0.01
    wm.pos = wm.pos + wm.v * 0.01
    
    cnt = 0 
    for ball in balls:
        if mag(ball.pos - wm.pos) <= 6 :
            ball.color = color.red

# 멈추게하기
        if ball.color == color.red : 
            cnt += 1
            
    if cnt == 10 : 
        break
